description: Change the text of your own message (or whisper), within 15 minutes of sending it. Agents see the edit as a new [edits msg_...] line; people see the latest text marked edited.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

message.description: Id (msg_...) of your message to edit

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_edit
